data.body:
CI BLOCKER, and it is NOT this change: change 1043 patchset 2 got Verified -1 twice (deterministic, not a flake — my first recheck comment guessed intermittent and was wrong).

Failure: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_differ.py::test_new_key_in_local_produces_outbound_create_mutation on macos-latest/py3.13, asserting isinstance(m, mutation_mod.Mutation) is False for an object that IS a Mutation — two class objects of the same name from a by-path module load.

Not caused by this story: it touches zero reconciler files, patchset 1 of this same change passed CI, and the reconciler suite passes locally. But this patchset ADDS tests, which changes xdist sharding, and that deterministically exposes a latent defect. So it is this change is blocked by it even though it did not cause it.

Root cause filed and fixed as bug 9f0b-3d48-b935-428b, pushed as Gerrit change 1050 off origin/main. Plan: land 1050 on main, then rebase this stack onto the new main so 1043 picks it up. Doing it that way rather than inserting a commit into the stack keeps an unrelated test-infra fix out of this story history.
